preconditions: Actual writer completed release and exact nine-path source snapshot native verification and publication exist.
Native GitRepositoryVerifier verifies the exact source commit/parent/all nine hashes without degradation.
Bind only actual writer/snapshot completion in living queue/checkpoint; leave d0 reviewer/final a3 ledger queued.
Native repository-verified queue validation passes and ready-only offers d0 before its claim.
commit_rule: Root publishes only these three process paths, records actual commit,parent,changed paths and all hashes in the reserved control-progress-receipt.json afterward; this normal commit creates no record IDs and is never labeled source/ledger archive completion.
final_ledger_rule: Final a3 owns the control-progress-receipt, living queue/checkpoint, actual fresh review and final disposition. Its ledger-control captures the already-published source-proof JSON and hash read from sourceproof; the unchanged proof is not restaged as a fake changed artifact. Exact Git verification of final ledger still uses only its actually changed declared paths.
own_final_proof_rule: Final a3 own proof stays outside repository or rederivable, with no recursive receipt archive.
